    Capture

    First capture? See the steps
    1. Install Veylet Capture on a LiDAR iPhone and sign in with this same email.
    2. Do one practice capture in a space you are allowed to record. The app shows the moves that matter and route checks. An automatic quality check assesses capture quality before confirming the next step.
    3. Save the space here — suburb or city only, no street address — then capture it on the approved route.
    4. Send from the app: it uploads in the background. Check your account for rendering status. The finished walkthrough appears in this space.
    5. Review the walkthrough here, tick that you have the right to share it, then press Approve and share. Anyone with its link can view or forward it.

    Account

    Account details

    Sign-in methods

      Email preferences

      Service emails about your account and walkthroughs still arrive, whatever you choose here.

      Finishing, exporting or leaving
      When a tour is finished
      Turn off its sharing under Manage sharing. New visitors are blocked at once; remove the link or embed from your listing too. Copies people already downloaded cannot be recalled.
      What stays
      Your spaces, walkthroughs and review history stay on this account until you ask for removal. A shared walkthrough stays online while your plan is active. When a plan ends, links, embeds and QR codes keep working for 14 days, then go offline until you restart the plan, unless you ask us for a hosting extension for a walkthrough; nothing is deleted, and its card shows the date.
      What you can take
      A file listing your spaces and tours. It holds no link secrets, imagery or scene files. Ask Veylet support about a full export of a delivered tour.
      Deleting your account

      Deleting your account cannot recall downloaded copies. Turn off sharing on live walkthroughs first. What is kept afterwards, and for how long, is in the terms.
